tips.label: 關係副詞
tips.text: 原因用 why、時間用 when、地點用 where；後面接主詞與動詞。

tips.label: 評論人的行為
tips.text: It + be + 形容詞 + of + 人 + to + 原形動詞。of 後的代名詞用受格。

notes.title: 關係副詞 why：原因
notes.description: why 引導關係子句，修飾表示原因的 reason，說明「……的原因」。
examples: That is the reason why he left in a hurry.（那就是他匆忙離開的原因。）

notes.title: 關係副詞 when：時間
notes.rule: 時間名詞 + when + S + V
notes.description: when 修飾 day、year、time、season 等時間名詞，在子句中表示時間。
examples: I remember the day when we met.（我記得我們見面的那一天。）

notes.title: 關係副詞 where：地點
notes.rule: 地點名詞 + where + S + V
notes.description: where 修飾 place、school、town 等地點名詞，在子句中表示地點。不能只看到時間或地點名詞就選 when 或 where，還要看子句缺什麼：若缺主詞或受詞，應考慮關係代名詞 that 或 which。
examples: This is the town where the expert lives.（這是那位專家居住的城鎮。）
This is the town that we visited.（這是我們參觀過的城鎮；visited 缺受詞，因此用 that。）

notes.title: It ... of 人 to V：評論人的行為
notes.rule: It + be + Adj + of + 人 + to V
notes.description: It 是虛主詞，to V 說明被評論的行為。常見形容詞有 kind、nice、polite、rude、honest、careless、foolish、smart。of 後用受格 me、him、her、us、them；to 後用原形動詞。be 依情境可用 is 或 was。
examples: It was polite of Ryan to open the door for me.（Ryan 幫我開門，真有禮貌。）
It was kind of the resident to help us.（那位居民幫助我們，真是好心。）

notes.title: 分清 of 和 for
notes.rule: 評論人的行為用 of；描述事情的難易等性質常用 for
notes.description: 本課重點是 of 人。kind、polite、rude 等用來評論人的行為；easy、difficult、important 等若描述事情對某人而言的性質，通常用 for 人。
examples: It was kind of him to help me.（他幫我，真是好心。）
It is easy for him to read this book.（讀這本書對他來說很容易。）

quiz.question: This is the reason ___ he apologized to me.
quiz.hint: reason 表示原因，後面用 why 引導原因的說明。

quiz.question: I remember the day ___ I bumped into our teacher.
quiz.hint: day 表示時間，子句已有主詞 I 和動詞 bumped，用 when。

quiz.question: This is the ancient town ___ my grandmother lives.
quiz.hint: town 是地點，lives 後缺地點資訊，用 where。

quiz.question: Do you know the reason ___ Amy left in a hurry?
quiz.hint: 先行詞 reason 表示原因，因此用 why。

quiz.question: Sunday is the day ___ we visit that resident.
quiz.hint: the day 表示時間，visit 已有受詞 that resident，用 when。

quiz.question: This is the room ___ the baby sleeps peacefully.
quiz.hint: room 表示地點，子句說明寶寶在哪裡睡覺，用 where。

quiz.question: Tell me the reason ___ you avoid that road.
quiz.hint: reason 後用 why 表示「為什麼避開那條路」。

quiz.question: I still remember the evening ___ the expert called me.
quiz.hint: evening 是時間，called 已有受詞 me，用 when。

quiz.question: That is the school ___ we learned this expression.
quiz.hint: school 表示地點，learned 已有受詞 this expression，用 where。

quiz.question: Nobody knows the reason ___ he denied the story.
quiz.hint: reason 是原因，後接 why 引導子句。

quiz.question: Summer is the season ___ we have plenty of free time.
quiz.hint: season 表示時間，子句完整，用 when 連接。

quiz.question: This is the park ___ I exercise to build up my strength.
quiz.hint: park 是運動的地點，用 where。

quiz.question: That is the reason ___ she wore a formal dress.
quiz.hint: reason 表示原因，用 why 說明穿正式洋裝的原因。

quiz.question: Do you remember the year ___ you moved here?
quiz.hint: year 表示時間，moved here 已有地點，用 when。

quiz.question: This is the classroom ___ our teacher explained the usage.
quiz.hint: classroom 是解釋用法的地點，用 where。

quiz.question: Can you explain the reason ___ this change is significant?
quiz.hint: reason 後用 why，引出這個改變重要的原因。

quiz.question: Night is the time ___ our town becomes quiet.
quiz.hint: time 表示時間，後面用 when。

quiz.question: This is the house ___ the friendly resident lives.
quiz.hint: house 是居住的地點，lives 在此不直接接受詞，用 where。

quiz.question: I understand the reason ___ friends influence your choices.
quiz.hint: reason 表示原因，用 why 引出朋友影響選擇的原因。

quiz.question: Monday was the day ___ he pointed out my mistake.
quiz.hint: day 是時間，pointed out 已有受詞 my mistake，用 when。

quiz.question: That is the library ___ we read about ancient society.
quiz.hint: library 是閱讀的地點，用 where。

quiz.question: She told me the reason ___ the two answers were more or less the same.
quiz.hint: reason 表示原因，後用 why。

quiz.question: I remember the morning ___ we first met the expert.
quiz.hint: morning 是時間，met 已有受詞 the expert，用 when。

quiz.question: This is the restaurant ___ we had a formal dinner.
quiz.hint: restaurant 是用餐地點，had 已有受詞 a formal dinner，用 where。

quiz.question: That is the reason ___ people refer to him as an expert.
quiz.hint: reason 後用 why，引出人們稱他為專家的原因。

quiz.question: It was kind ___ the resident to show us the way.
quiz.hint: kind 評論居民幫忙的行為，使用 It was kind of 人 to V。

quiz.question: It was polite of Jack ___ after he bumped into me.
quiz.hint: It was polite of 人 後接 to 加原形動詞。

quiz.question: It was careless of ___ to leave the door open.
quiz.hint: of 是介系詞，這裡的人稱代名詞用受格 him。

quiz.question: ___ was nice of you to point out the mistake.
quiz.hint: 固定句型以虛主詞 It 開頭，真正評論的行為放在 to V。

quiz.question: It was rude ___ him to shout at the resident.
quiz.hint: rude 評論人的行為，用 of 人。

quiz.question: It was honest of Mary to ___ the truth.
quiz.hint: 不定詞 to 後接原形動詞 tell。

quiz.question: It was kind of ___ to share their food with us.
quiz.hint: of 後用受格 them，表示分享食物的那些人。

quiz.question: It was polite of the expert ___ to our questions.
quiz.hint: It was polite of 人 後接 to V，用 to listen。

quiz.question: It was nice ___ you to explain this expression.
quiz.hint: nice 評論你解釋用語的行為，搭配 of you。

quiz.question: It was foolish of Ben to ___ the same mistake again.
quiz.hint: to 後接原形動詞 make，不能用過去式或動名詞。

quiz.question: It was kind of ___ to help the ancient town's residents.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 of 後表示行為者，用受格 her。

quiz.question: ___ was rude of him to deny everything without listening.
quiz.hint: It 作虛主詞，後面的 to deny everything 才是被評論的行為。

quiz.question: It was smart ___ you to avoid that busy road.
quiz.hint: smart 用來評論你避開繁忙道路的決定，用 of you。

quiz.question: It was nice of the teacher to ___ the usage again.
quiz.hint: 不定詞 to 後接原形動詞 explain。

quiz.question: It was careless of ___ to lose our tickets.
quiz.hint: of 後接受格 us，不能用主格 we 或所有格 our。

quiz.question: It was kind of the expert ___ us build up our skills.
quiz.hint: of 人 後接 to 加原形動詞，選 to help。

quiz.question: It was polite ___ Amy to thank everyone at the formal dinner.
quiz.hint: polite 評論 Amy 道謝的行為，用 of Amy。

quiz.question: It was rude of him to ___ while I was speaking.
quiz.hint: to 後使用原形動詞 laugh。

quiz.question: It was honest of ___ to admit that I was in a hurry.
quiz.hint: of 後的人稱代名詞須用受格 me。

quiz.question: ___ was kind of the residents to give us plenty of water.
quiz.hint: 固定句型為 It was kind of 人 to V，用 It 作虛主詞。

quiz.question: It was foolish ___ him to ignore such a significant change.
quiz.hint: foolish 評論人的行為，搭配 of him。

quiz.question: It was nice of you to ___ the baby sleep peacefully.
quiz.hint: to 後接原形動詞 let；整體使用 It was nice of you to V。

quiz.question: It was polite of ___ to use that expression.
quiz.hint: of 後指出行為者，使用受格 him。

quiz.question: It was kind of Lisa ___ me when I was lost.
quiz.hint: It was kind of Lisa 後須接 to V，選 to call。

quiz.question: It was careless ___ me to write the wrong name.
quiz.hint: careless 評論我寫錯名字的行為，句型使用 of me。
